title: Digest for 12 to 18 October 2026 (through 15 October)
summary: The week is still running: this issue lists changes published up to 15 October 2026. Each item quotes the source wording and links to it.

items.title: Origin App Marketplace
items.text: Origin now integrates with over 20 apps for deployments, CI, code review, security, monitoring, and project management, from partners including Cloudflare, Linear, Sentry, and Socket Security.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.299
items.text: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS` environment variable: Claude gets the paths of `@` file mentions to read with its file tools, not the files' contents

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.301
items.text: Added the `%` motion to vim mode: jump to the matching bracket, alone or with d/c/y

items.title: Codex 0.163.0
items.text: Open `/config` to search preferences across categories, change supported settings immediately, and see which changes require a restart.

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon in GitHub Copilot
items.text: Gemini 4 Argon, Google’s newest frontier model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot.

items.title: Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models in mid-November
items.text: We will deprecate the following models across all GitHub Copilot experiences (including Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions) on November 16th, 2026
